description: This file defines theme-related functions for a frontend project, including a base theme object with colors, typography, radius, and elevation settings, as well as functions to generate color palettes and category-to-color mappings based on the theme.

methods.name: getOceanTheme
methods.description: Returns the Ocean Professional base theme tokens including colors, typography, radius, and elevation settings.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette
methods.description: Generates a deterministic color palette for categorical data, seeded by the theme's primary and secondary colors.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap
methods.description: Maps category names to colors from the categorical palette, maintaining stable order.
